title: Oriflame parfüm ve kolonya
bio: Oriflame markasının koku veri tabanımızda 425 parfümü bulunmaktadır. En eski ürün 1990 yılında, en yenisi ise 2026 yılında piyasaya sürülmüştür. Oriflame parfümler parfümörlerle işbirliği içinde yapılmıştır Bernard Ellena, Francis Kurkdjian, Alexis Dadier, Emilie Coppermann, Fabienne Coupaye, Celine Ripert, Philippine Courtière, Philippe Bousseton, Nathalie Feisthauer, Marie Salamagne, Veronique Nyberg, Mark Buxton, Evelyne Boulanger, Fabrice Pellegrin, Julien Rasquinet, Christian Vermorel, Ilias Ermenidis, Jean-Christophe Hérault, Dora Baghriche, Alexandra Carlin, Nadege Le Garlantezec, Nicole Mayu, Margherita Carini, Suzy Le Helley, Guillaume Flavigny, Clement Gavarry, Florent Jubert, Alienor Massenet, Amandine Clerc-Marie, Honorine Blanc, Sophie Labbe, Gilbert Apollon, Nicolas Beaulieu, Nelly Hachem-Ruiz, Maurice Roucel, Fanny Bal, Maxime Exler, Nathalie Lorson, Gil Clavien, Jean Jacques, Vincent Schaller, Christiane Plos, Philippe Roques, Christianne Plos, Frank Voelkl, Caroline Dumur, Adilson Rato, Lucas Sieuzac, Richard Herpin, Violaine David, Pierre Negrin, Nicolas Bonneville, Ashley Santiago, Nadège Le Garlantezec, Claude Chaubert, Francoise Caron, Sébastien Cresp, Randa Hammami, Daphné Bugey, Sonia Constant, Thierry Wasser, Elise Benat, Olivier Cresp, Natalie Gracia-Cetto, Louise Turner, Benoist Lapouza, Leslie Gauthier, Marine Ipert, Alexis Grugeon, Dorothée Piot, Valerie Garnuch-Mentzel, Andrea Montanari, Jacek Laszczynski, Hamid Merati-Kashani ve Pierre-Constantin Guéros.
